description: Alert System Helps Strawberry Growers Reduce Costs is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Florida | Gulf Coast Research and Education Center. In Florida's humid climate, strawberry growers are in a constant battle with two kinds of fruit rot. Using a decision support system, they can save money by spraying fields only when the plant diseases are a threat. Coverage: Florida (2014). The toolkit gives Florida as the location, 2014 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
